webster.text: Entreaty; humble and earnest prayer in worship.

more.text: In Roman antiquity, a religious solemnity observed in consequence of some military success.

example.quote: How can that government be strong which depends on humble supplications for its support ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
